name: Lag Reducer
description: Stronger particle-budget optimization with live settings in the level pause menu.

enabled.name: Enable particle optimization
enabled.description: Master switch. Turn off to restore normal particle budgets and emission rates.

particle-draw-reduction.name: Particle optimization strength
particle-draw-reduction.description: 0 = normal. 1-10 progressively reduce particle emission and max capacity; 8 keeps 10%, 9 keeps 6%, and 10 keeps about 3% of each emitter's original particle budget. High values remove most particle effects. Does not optimize every type of level object or glow.
